{"notes": "Visit 4 (6:00). Everything is dark, so it is all connected to the start. The bottom line is clean. The top line is still doubled or overlapping from about x=9 to x=19, with no visible fix. That is redundant and a possible misfire on the push, and I haven't seen it resolved. There are no hand labels, so I still can't say who placed what and won't score on attribution. The facilitator announced 5 minutes left and said only what is connected to the start will fall.

Tom: Said 'Sounds good, all. Fish looks like a fish. I'll keep my hands off and just shout if anything tips.' It is sensible to stop touching a connected build, but he didn't mention the overlap. Others treat the upper fork as his and it is built and connected, but I have never seen him place anything. Still ask him directly what he built. Possibly a quiet but real contributor; unverified.

Maya: Silent this visit. Earlier she handed over the fork and acted as quality checker. Leadership still looks strongest. Execution is unverified.

Priya: Silent this visit. Earlier she checked connectivity and offered help closing gaps. Collaborative. Ask her privately about the overlap and the role changes.

Leo: Silent this visit. He said he would check the doubled back, but it is still doubled. Good intent, no visible result.

Next: watch the push, which is the real test of whether the overlap misfires. Then ask each person privately who built what and who knew about the doubling. Hold ratings until then. Provisional view: Maya leadership and collaboration are strong, Priya collaboration is good, Leo and Tom impact and execution are unclear."}
